song_craft: Voice: intimate-address couplets (second person throughout — the whole work is one prayer in five postures). Arc: total offering (v1) → victory cry (v2) → complaint turned doctrine (v3) → assurance dissolving doubt (v4) → confession pleading presence (v5). Bhakti postures, not arguments: vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: O Maheśa — at Your door let my charming speech flash forth, faultless: ‘Victory, victory to Maheśa,’ unceasing.
Let this auspicious speech bring me bliss forever. O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — protected, O Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho
notes: śivadā as bliss-bringing; Śiva-giving reading open

verses.craft: Victory-doubled cry kept doubled (row 6: refrain never reworded); śivadā bliss-reading per note, Śiva-giving open; protector-chiasmus kept (whose-protector-is…protected).
verses.rejected: (a) single Victory → killed: doubling is the cry. (b) Śiva-giving → killed: L3 note freezes bliss, open noted.
